prompts.promptEn: Greet a new colleague. Say that you are new and which team you work in.
prompts.promptAr: حيِّ زميلًا جديدًا. قل إنك جديد، وفي أي فريق تعمل.
prompts.sample: Good morning. Nice to meet you. I am a new engineer here. I work in the design team.

prompts.promptEn: You did not understand something in a meeting. Ask politely.
prompts.promptAr: لم تفهم شيئًا في اجتماع. اسأل بأدب.
prompts.sample: Sorry, I don't understand. Could you say that again, please? What does this word mean?

prompts.promptEn: A colleague helped you. Thank them.
prompts.sample: Thank you for your help. I really appreciate it.

prompts.promptEn: Ask about the time of a meeting, and say that you will come.
prompts.promptAr: اسأل عن موعد اجتماع، وقل إنك ستحضر.
prompts.sample: What time is the meeting? Thank you. I will be there.

prompts.promptEn: Ask a colleague to send you a file, and say when you need it.
prompts.promptAr: اطلب من زميل أن يرسل لك ملفًا، وقل متى تحتاجه.
prompts.sample: Could you send me the file, please? I need it by Thursday.

prompts.promptEn: Review: greet someone, ask for help, and thank them.
prompts.promptAr: مراجعة: حيِّ شخصًا، واطلب المساعدة، ثم اشكره.
prompts.sample: Good morning. Can you help me, please? Thank you for your help.

prompts.promptEn: Your manager asks about your report. Give a short update.
prompts.promptAr: يسألك مديرك عن تقريرك. أعطِ تحديثًا قصيرًا.
prompts.sample: I'm working on it. It's almost finished. I'll send it today.

prompts.promptEn: Tell your supervisor about a problem with a machine.
prompts.sample: There is a problem with the pump. I will check it now.

prompts.promptEn: A delivery is late. Say sorry and say when it will be ready.
prompts.promptAr: التوريد متأخر. اعتذر، وقل متى سيكون جاهزًا.
prompts.sample: Sorry for the delay. The delivery is late. It will be ready tomorrow.

prompts.promptEn: In a meeting, agree with one idea and say you are not sure about another.
prompts.promptAr: في اجتماع، وافق على فكرة، وقل إنك لست متأكدًا من فكرة أخرى.
prompts.sample: I agree. That's a good idea. But I'm not sure about the cost. Let's discuss it tomorrow.

prompts.promptEn: Review: give an update, and say that something is late.
prompts.promptAr: مراجعة: أعطِ تحديثًا، وقل إن شيئًا ما متأخر.
prompts.sample: I'm working on the report. Sorry for the delay. It will be ready tomorrow.

prompts.promptEn: Give two safety instructions to a new worker on site.
prompts.promptAr: أعطِ عاملًا جديدًا في الموقع تعليمتين للسلامة.
prompts.sample: Please wear your helmet. Be careful, the floor is wet.

prompts.promptEn: Call an office. Ask for a person, and leave a message.
prompts.promptAr: اتصل بمكتب. اطلب شخصًا، واترك رسالة.
prompts.sample: Can I speak to Mr. Hassan, please? Can I leave a message? Please tell him I'll call him back.

prompts.promptEn: Say goodbye to your colleagues at the end of the day.
prompts.promptAr: ودّع زملاءك في آخر يوم العمل.
prompts.sample: I'm leaving now. Thanks for today. See you tomorrow. Have a good evening.

prompts.promptEn: Introduce yourself for about 30 seconds: your name, your job, your team, and one thing you do at work.
prompts.promptAr: عرّف بنفسك في نحو 30 ثانية: اسمك، ومهنتك، وفريقك، وشيئًا واحدًا تفعله في العمل.
prompts.sample: Good morning. My name is Omar. I am a civil engineer, and I work in the design team. I check drawings and I visit the site every week. I am learning English for my work. I can ask for help, and I can write short messages. Nice to meet you.
